title: Akiyama Mizuki — Making Chocolates With Children〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: A Gentleman Thief's Thrilling White Day?!

rows.Line: White Day
Kamiyama High School - Class 1-A

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Morning, An!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hey, Mizuki!
Fancy seeing you here in the morning.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha! I ran into Li'l Bro just now and he said the exact same thing.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But I need to be here today since it's White Day♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Ta-daa! Happy White Day!
My thanks for Valentine's Day.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Thanks, Mizuki!
I have something for you too... Here, Happy White Day!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hehe♪ Thanks, An!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Speaking of which, how was the Chocolate Factory? You went to make chocolates with Akito, right?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, about that!
You gotta hear what happened! It was so awesome!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Really?! Tenma was supposed to perform in this show as an extra but his mascot partner couldn't stop crying?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, we weren't sure what was gonna happen at first.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But Tsukasa and I worked together to make chocolates with all the little kids, while Li'l Bro helped our mascot friend settle down...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It was a total frenzy but really fun at the same time!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Cool. I would've loved to see how you and Akito acted!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I didn't say much, but Li'l Bro was a pro♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: The way he went all out with his bright and cheerful big brother persona was so great!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: For more on that, you should probably ask him yourself.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha. I think I will when we get together for practice later.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Anyway, thanks for the chocolates.
And bravo, Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yup♪ Thank you too, An!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I can't thank you enough for treating me like a normal person...)
bgm_area00005
Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Heya, Miku, Rin!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Welcome, Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hm? What's in the bag...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I went to this place called the Chocolate Factory the other day to make some chocolates.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Here are some souvenirs!
They turned out super cute, so they also make for good eye candy.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'd like it if you could share some with MEIKO and Luka.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Okay, we will...
Thank you, Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, they're chocolate butterflies...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, they're very cute.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, Mizuki, you're already here.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hey, there you are! Actually, I just got here. I was giving Miku and Rin their souvenirs♪

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: From the Chocolate Factory...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yup! We were allowed to make as much as we wanted, so I decided to make some for Miku and everyone else.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Mine's a butterfly.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
What?! That looks amazing!
The wings are lined too neatly and they're colored really nicely!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Heh heh heh. I made them using the silicone molds they had at the Chocolate Factory♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: They had an even more complicated one with finer lines and stuff, but I decided to go with something simpler.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It's beautiful.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, it is...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
You like it that much, Rin?
Awesome!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Okay, we get it.
Does that mean you made us butterflies too?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I made something different for each of you♪ Here, take a look!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Mine's a flower...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I got wings...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
No way! The petals look so real!
And the curvature of these wings! It's like they're really wafting in the breeze!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Kanade's flower was originally supposed to be a rose. Unfortunately, it was hard to make thin petals, so it kinda ended up looking more like a tulip...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I wanted to make the wings look fuller too, but that also became way too hard. So, I decided to just make them look the part!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I didn't know you could make anything like this out of chocolate.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I'm just as surprised.
Thank you, Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
You're welcome!
You should open yours too, Ena!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Okay! What do I get?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Huh? Is this...?
A pancake...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yup! A pancake-shaped chocolate that's colored to look just like the real deal♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Do you know how hard it was to get it to look this fluffy? Also, like how the chocolate sauce turned out? Pretty good, right?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Y-Yeah, I guess so...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But you made everyone else these really artistic chocolates, while me... It's like you're trying to make me mad or something...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I have no idea what you're talking about.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wait, that look just now! You did this on purpose!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Whoa! Miku, save me from Ena!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: H-Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hey, don't use Miku as a shield!
